preconditions.description: The input S must be a string.
The length of string S must be between 1 and 5 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The returned list contains all unique permutations of S, sorted in lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(item, str) for item in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every element in the returned list is a string.
The returned list is sorted in lexicographical order.
The returned list contains no duplicate strings.
